description: This file defines the PreparedTimer interface, part of a metrics instrumentation library used for timing operations. It extends existing metric instrument interfaces and provides methods for starting timers, recording time durations, and accessing total recorded time and record count.

classes.name: PreparedTimer
classes.description: An interface representing a timer metric that can be prepared to start, record durations, and provide total time and record count.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer, returning a StartedTimer instance. Package-private to restrict access.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a specified amount of time in a given TimeUnit, returning the PreparedTimer for chaining.

methods.name: getTotalTime
methods.description: Returns the sum of all recorded times in nanoseconds.

methods.name: getNumberOfRecords
methods.description: Returns the total number of recorded timing events.
